?

Psalms 125:3 MSG
The fist of the wicked will never violate What is due the righteous, provoking wrongful violence.
?
Everything due you;
In your office,
In your family,
In business,
In academics,
In marriage will not be truncated or violated by the intervention of your antagonists.✔

?They will always be late in rising to the occasion.
?You would have received and celebrated before they hear of it.
?
The Lord will make you wiser than all your antagonists in Jesus name
